Jordan: Quick poll—tiny emergency: you can grab exactly one desk item before you evacuate. One word answers only. GO.
Maria: plant :seedling:
Sam: mug :coffee:
Alex: headphones
Priya: keyboard
Jordan: scoreboard so far: plant 1, mug 1, headphones 1, keyboard 1
Sam: also, if snacks count it's game over :cookie:
Maria: @Sam noted. but plant > crumbs
Dev-Bot: Heads up — today's fire-drill set for 15:00. Please don't actually evacuate with plants unless necessary. :bell:
Jordan: @Dev-Bot thanks, but imagination is on fire :fire:
Alex: Can we have a "desk fort" rescue option next time? :fort:
Priya: real answer is 'laptop' but that's cheating
Sam: Laptop if we get two words: 'laptop + charger'
Jordan: OK final tie-breaker: emoji vote react below :thumbsup: for plant, :coffee: for mug, :headphones: for headphones, :keyboard: for keyboard
Maria: :thumbsup:
Alex: :headphones:
Priya: :keyboard:
Sam: :coffee:
Jordan: Results close enough — democracy is messy. Winner: unanimous chaos.
Maria: Bonus kudos to whoever waters the plant this week :pray:
Alex: I will if someone claims the last muffin from the kitchen fridge :innocent:
Sam: I will claim the muffin. Plant sacrifice accepted.
Jordan: Meeting adjourned. Tiny heroics only, folks.
